title.narrative: UNESCO Support to World Audio Visual & Entertainment Summit (WAVES) in India: Advancing Multilingualism, Indigenous Languages and Inclusive Digital Ecosystems

description.narrative: UNESCO will support the World Audio Visual Entertainment Summit through a main component on audiovisual heritage preservation, access and digital futures, alongside complementary work on policy dialogue, capacity-building and cultural diversity. This component will focus on strengthening the preservation, digitisation and public access of audiovisual heritage, including content in multilingual, Indigenous and underrepresented languages, and will promote international cooperation and knowledge-sharing on inclusive digital access. Within this broader engagement, the regular programme funds will specifically support the multilingualism dimension of the audiovisual heritage work, contributing to more equitable access to audiovisual content in the digital environment and to the preservation and promotion of Indigenous languages.
